title: Module 6 Quiz: Future of Decentralized Finance

questions.text: What is a recommended practice for maintaining a disciplined DeFi learning routine?
options: Spend hours each day chasing hype on social media.
Allocate a regular time each week to review protocols, track updates, and check developer activity.
Invest all funds into the newest yield farm without research.
Rely solely on influencers for investment advice.
questions.explanation: Setting a regular weekly time to review protocols and updates supports consistent, informed learning.

questions.text: True or false: You should never commit capital to a yield pool or protocol unless you can explain its source of yield clearly to a friend.
questions.explanation: If you cannot describe where the yield comes from in plain language, you are effectively providing the yield yourself.

questions.text: Which storage method is advised for protecting primary DeFi assets from online threats?
options: Leaving funds on a centralized exchange’s hot wallet.
Storing assets in a hardware wallet offline.
Writing the seed phrase on a public forum.
Sharing private keys with friends for backup.
questions.explanation: Hardware wallets keep private keys offline, protecting assets from online hacks.

questions.text: True or false: Tokenised real‑world assets remove all regulatory concerns because they are purely digital.
questions.explanation: Tokenised RWAs still face regulatory scrutiny and may be treated as securities requiring disclosures.
